receipt.summary: All must-fix criteria satisfied. Task isolation: FounderPilot now caches workers per requestId and validates requestId against inbox before any operation; history/evidence filtered by requestId. Explicit-save/no-auto-run: save action validates feedback (1-2000 chars), is idempotent, never triggers runner; run/coordinate blocked while active.has(requestId) except save; save during work queues next revision without launch. Journal evidence: events include requestId, revision, executionId, baseRevision, baseArtifactHash, correctionCount; handoff.acknowledged emits artifactHash matching accepted contract. Restart history: history() loads persisted JSON, marks interrupted coordination stages, preserves sharedRevisions reference across save/load; restart pilot reproduces identical revision array and statuses. Queued revisions during active run: AC-03 demonstrates save during running creates queued revision with parentRevision linkage, run throws while active, queued revision persists after completion and can be run next. Authorization: requestId format regex enforced, inbox membership checked, cross-task access throws. UI: inbox.js fetches per-task evidence via requestId query param; buttons disable correctly using anyRunning flag covering running/reviewing/coordination states; revision cards show createdAt/startedAt/completedAt/acceptedAt timestamps. Test quality: AC-01 through AC-04 cover isolation, validation, idempotency, explicit run/accept, save-during-work queuing, chronology metadata, restart survival, evidence filtering; all pass with zero model calls on save operations and proper async waiting.
